node.title: Re: Bash script to perl script
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [acrobat118],

Here's a rough outline of what you'll need:

  1. Read a file and loop over its lines: [doc://perlintro#Files-and-I/O|"Files and I/O" in perlintro] (also covers how to write to an output file)
  2. Act only on lines that match a pattern (grep): [doc://perlintro#Regular-expressions|"Regular expressions" in perlintro]
  3. Break a line into columns (awk): [doc://split], e.g. my @F = split; splits the current line $_ on whitespace; the first column is then $F[0], second column $F[1], etc.
  4. Operate only on lines that match certain conditions (awk): [doc://perlintro#Conditional-and-looping-constructs|"Conditional and looping constructs" in perlintro] and the section following it "Builtin operators and functions"
  5. Adding the resulting items to an array: [doc://push] (for a more advanced approach see "arrays of arrays" in [doc://perldsc])
  6. Sorting the array: [doc://sort] and [doc://perlfaq4#How-do-I-sort-an-array-by-(anything)?|"How do I sort an array by (anything)?" in perlfaq4]

Try using this information to write some code, and if you run into trouble feel free to ask here.

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
